in_sanskrit.name: धन्नजय
in_sanskrit.meaning: धन्न (Dhanan) - God of wealth, prosperity and abundance, जय (Jaya) - Victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings victory through wealth and prosperity. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'धनन्' (Dhanan), which means 'God of wealth, prosperity and abundance'. The suffix 'जय' (Jaya) is added to denote victory.

in_hindi.name: धन्नजय
in_hindi.meaning: धन्न (Dhanan) - धन (Dhan) - धनी (Dhani) - धनपति (Dhanpati) - धनवान (Dhanavan) - God of wealth, prosperity and abundance, जय (Jaya) - वजह (Vajah) - विजय (Vijay) - जीत (Jit) - Victory

in_tamil.name: தண்ணாஜய்
in_tamil.meaning: தண்ண (Thannan) - தன்னை (Thanai) - God of wealth, prosperity and abundance, ஜய (Jayam) - Victory

in_telugu.name: ధన్నజేయ్
in_telugu.meaning: ధన్న (Dhananamu) - ధనపతి (Dhanapati) - ధనేశ్వర (Dhaneshvara) - God of wealth, prosperity and abundance, జేయ (Jeyam) - జీయ (Jeyi) - Victory

in_marathi.name: Dhannjay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's wealth, prosperity
